start_index_server: start a distributed FAISS index server on a specified port with IPv4 or IPv6 support
create_index: create a new FAISS index with a given index ID and configuration on the server
add_index_data: add embeddings and optional metadata to an existing FAISS index on the server
search_index: search a FAISS index with a query batch and return top-k nearest neighbors
sync_train_index: synchronously train a FAISS index on the server to prepare it for search operations
